When I woke up, I found myself back three years ago, with a fiancée by my side…
Since this is a match made in heaven, let’s fight zombies together to level up, and have a little romance while we’re at it…

90005.synopsis:
“I’m just being myself, but for some reason, people say I’m kind (sweating).”
Dill should have died after his fiancé unilaterally broke their mating bond.
However, when he woke up, he found himself in a world where Omegas were revered as the highest class, a complete reversal from his previous world where they were at the bottom!
The owner of this body was named Dilrekia, a ridiculously selfish, tyrannical, and narcissistic young man.
In this world, Omegas are protected by the temple and raised in luxury in ‘Paradise.’
And it’s the Omega who chooses their Alpha mate.
Here, the temple, which wields healing magic, holds the highest authority, and male Omegas are revered as mystical beings.
The person chosen by an Omega receives the temple’s generous protection.
Even the youngest royal can ascend to the throne, fallen nobles regain their former glory, and commoners can be elevated to nobility. The benefits are endless.
It seems Dilrekia had several marriage candidates and enjoyed toying with them like a little devil.
Of course, Dill couldn’t possibly do such a thing. While enjoying his peaceful life, he dreads meeting the candidates.
Moreover, one of them is none other than Alfred, the man who abandoned him in his previous world.
Dill, who feels nothing but nausea when he sees Alfred, runs away and is surprised by the knight who comes to his rescue.
It’s the very same guard knight who never abandoned him in his previous world.
Dill gradually becomes close to the knight and a young civil official, finding his heart torn between the two.
Transported to a parallel world and forced to live as Dilrekia, Dill’s wish is to “build a warm and cozy family.”
So, which path will lead Dill to a peaceful tomorrow?

91029.synopsis:
Loving He Jinsheng was a gamble where I wagered everything I had.
I am the cold and aloof movie king of the entertainment industry. He Jinsheng chased me for three years before finally winning me over. Everyone said the young master of the He family had fallen for a man.
But on our anniversary, I overheard someone ask him what it felt like to be in a relationship with me.
With a cigarette between his fingers, He Jinsheng carelessly blew out a smoke ring and said, “Kissing a man? It’s pretty disgusting.”

92309.synopsis:
Mu Ling, who lived on a rural planet, inherited a zoo from her great-aunt whom she had never met.
❀
In this interstellar era, mutant beasts run rampant. 
War beasts left disabled or severely injured after fighting against these creatures are sent to willing zoos to live out their remaining days, unable to find peace elsewhere.
Looking at the zoo full of old, weak, sick, and injured beasts, Mu Ling couldn’t imagine how much money she’d need to make to support this large family!
To promote the zoo, Mu Ling created a StarNet account, posting photos of the animals in hopes of attracting visitors.
Soon after, a video of a high-risk retired S-class war beast, the Ripper Tiger, calmly allowing its claws to be trimmed went viral on StarNet!
Then more shocking videos surfaced…
An S-Class Swiftfire Leopard, completely unfazed even when its tail was pulled!
An S-Class Silver Snow Bear submitting to a bath without any resistance!
An S-Class Dark Snow Wolf, voluntarily bringing its cubs to the zookeeper to be raised.
Netizens: ???? Is this a sci-fi movie?
What? 
These once-fierce, terrifying retired S-class war beasts—known for becoming increasingly antisocial, paranoid, and even biting their own masters after injury—can now be viewed by the public?
No, no, no, zookeeper, wake up!
Injured war beasts are mentally unstable and can go berserk at any moment! Don’t gamble with visitors’ lives!!
–
The galaxy’s first zoo, capable of calming the mental energy of injured war beasts and giving them a peaceful, happy life in their twilight years, has appeared. In disbelief, Federation officials from various departments rushed to investigate.
The entire research team from the Imperial Military Beast Department came for a team-building excursion.
Professors and outstanding students from the five major Beast Taming Academies uniformly arranged an autumn field trip.
Officials from the Healing Beast Supply Center hurried over to learn.
The principal of the Search and Rescue Beast Training Academy came to work part-time at his own expense.
Even the President and the First Lady personally visited for an inspection tour.
Mu Ling, now rolling in money: …I feel like I could open branch zoos!
Ps: The female protagonist has a hidden identity; there’s a reason why animals are drawn to her.
–
One-sentence summary: I run a zoo in the Interstellar era.
Theme: Self-reliance and self-improvement

To top it off, he spots a mysterious beast running through the forest in the early morning!?

93845.synopsis:
On the day of the start of winter, Zhu Shiyu broke up with her boyfriend of four years and returned to Wenbei City.  
The hospital room was a mess; her mother’s face was pale. Faced with the reasonable persuasion of various relatives and friends, she was left with two choices: To marry as arranged by her family or to resign from her job.  
Zhu Shiyu chose the former, and then she met Meng Siyi.
In everyone’s eyes, Meng Siyi had good looks, a good job, and an impeccable personality, making their marriage a step up for Zhu Shiyu.  
Only Meng Siyi knew.

94869.synopsis:
Yu Zhengzheng pursued her senior brother relentlessly for seven whole years, serving him tea, fetching water, washing clothes, cooking meals—humbling herself into the dust.
When her senior brother was hunted by the infamous Ghost King, feared across the Six Realms, she unhesitatingly took a fatal sword strike meant for him.
Upon waking, her memories returned, and she recalled that she had transmigrated into a tragic romance-filled cultivation novel, becoming the male lead’s “white moonlight,” a cherished but doomed memory.
Soon after, her senior brother went crazy due to his martial arts practice and stripped her skin and bones to turn her into a specimen.
In his later clarity, to save the last fragment of her soul, he would forcibly take the female lead’s heart blood. After the female lead endured disfigurement, amnesia, and a pregnancy escape, he would, in a grand gesture to win her back, personally destroy Zhengzheng’s remaining soul fragment.
Awakened to her fate, Yu Zhengzheng tore up the plot on the spot: “f*ck you!”
Hearing that the Ghost Sect was recruiting, she packed her belongings and rushed to join her senior brother’s mortal enemy—the Ghost King.
—
At the interview.
Yu Zhengzheng showered the Ghost King with unreserved flattery: “The Ghost King is unparalleled, elegant, and the one I’ve secretly admired for ages.”
The Ghost King, sitting behind beaded curtains, fingered prayer beads as his gaze turned unreadable. “I hear you once took a sword for my enemy. Do you like him?”
Yu Zhengzheng smiled brightly. “How could that be? He’s just a toad dreaming of swan meat. I only blocked the sword by accident when I slipped.”
—
One day, as she attended to the Ghost King during his bath, Yu Zhengzheng accidentally tore off his human-skin mask.
Staring at a face identical to her senior brother’s, she stammered and cautiously probed, “Are you and my senior brother… blood brothers?”
The Ghost King narrowed his eyes, raised his lips and chuckled: “No, I am that toad.”

95637.synopsis:
Kang Rion is an S-class Esper suffering from chronic lack of guiding. What’s the point of having abilities called the strongest in history when his matching rate hovers around only 30 percent? Because of this, Rion had been working as an Esper while slowly consuming his lifespan. Ignoring concerns that he might die from overwork, he continued working with the mindset that his body didn’t matter as long as he could save people. Then one day, a savior – no, an S-class guide with a 99 percent matching rate appeared like a miracle.
He was excited about meeting a guide with the highest matching rate in history, thinking he could now save more people without worrying about guiding. However, he encountered an unexpected variable. Though the matching rate was definitely high…
“I told you to watch your mouth.”
“I remember telling you several times to take care of yourself too.”
Their personalities clash terribly. Of course, he tried to get along well, if only for the sake of guiding.
“Not much to you, is there?”
“What?”
“If being the strongest Esper means rushing to defeat bosses while getting injured without even realizing it, then I guess being the strongest Esper isn’t all that special.”
Still, wrong is wrong. He thought if someone dislikes him, he could just dislike them back. But this person… is truly puzzling.
‘I think there’s a misunderstanding. I don’t dislike you.’
How should I think about you, who confuses people with inexplicable words just when I’m about to dislike you?

97173.synopsis:
In a land where ancient families are as common as the stars, the weight of millennia-old legacies brings not only honor but also the chains of rigid traditions. Here, bloodlines are the cornerstone of power, the unyielding foundation for climbing the ladder of authority.
But what hope does the descendant of a mere hunter have in such a world? How can they claim a seat at the table in this grand feast of ambition and betrayal? Is it through the fragmented remnants of a cheat ability from the game For Honor, now warped and unrecognizable? A fleeting glimpse into an uncertain future? Or perhaps a stroke of intangible, invisible luck?
The stage is set, the pieces are moving—will this unlikely contender rise, or will they become just another casualty of the Game of Thrones?

97429.synopsis:
Hai San’er x Lu Xie
Pure Mermaid Top x Hot-Tempered, Rough-Handed Bottom
Lu Xie, injured on a mission, hides out in a small seaside shop to recover. One day, while working at the shop, a wavy silver-haired handsome man walks in.
Hai San’er: “I’m pregnant.”
Lu Xie (rolling his eyes): “You’re crazy. You’re a guy—how can you be pregnant?”
Hai San’er: “I’m a mermaid.”
Lu Xie (slightly patient, but not much): “Even if you’re a mermaid, you’re still a male fish.”

97941.synopsis:
[Crossing the border + space + sweet love + marriage first, love later + raising children + family affairs] 
Su Xieqiu grew up without the love of her father or mother. Her grandparents, who raised her, also passed away early. She worked hard to buy a house in the big city, but when she woke up one day, she found herself transported back to the planned economy era of the 1970s.
The original owner was an educated youth who went to the countryside. She was cowardly and a little confused. Because she was beautiful, she was framed by a female educated youth and married to Han Zhenyu, a gangster in the village.
There was no one in Han Zhenyu’s family who was easy to deal with. His father didn’t care about anything, his mother was a stepmother, and none of the brothers and sisters born by the stepmother were easy to mess with.
Han Zhenyu was often not at home, so the whole family treated the original owner as a punching bag for the old mother in the family. She had an argument with her sister-in-law two days ago and hit her head on a stone and died.
Su Xieqiu smiled coldly. This was really a vicious family, but she was not the original owner. In the face of injustice, she chose to go crazy and be a top-notch person that others dared not mess with, and let those who bullied her know why the flowers were so red.
As for the second-rate husband who had never slept with her, Su Xieqiu considered whether to kick him out and live on her own.
But what she didn’t know was that Han Zhenyu also thought she was a troublemaker and was trying to get her back to the city and then divorce her.
Later, Su Xieqiu became a tough wife in the village, and the man who wanted to divorce her treated her like a treasure…

100501.synopsis:
The young princess Robellia, who had been living a monotonous life, met an unexpected guest.
“Are you the son of Duke Roxas?”
“Yes. I am Akan Roxas.”
Akan, with sparkling silver hair and violet eyes tinged with red, was a beautiful boy, even more so than a doll. Robellia enjoyed spending time with him.
“I heard them talking about the Duchy’s independence. Could that be the reason?”
However, Robellia’s careless mistake in making Akan her playmate caused chaos in the palace. Duke Roxas was falsely accused of treason and executed, while Akan was reduced to s*avery.
Then, ten years later, there was a real rebellion.

Chi Suisui was seen holding the national flag, her eyes smiling brightly.
This photo instantly exploded on the internet, earning praise both domestically and internationally.
After the Olympics, outdoor streamers at the airport captured He Xingwang cradling a sleeping girl in his arms.

The live chat erupted.

Netizens: I want this kind of childhood betrothal too!
One day, during Chi Suisui’s concert, a billionaire CEO and his wife, a national treasure musician, attended together. When interviewed by an obscure tabloid, they lavished excessive praise on her performance, sparking heated online debates.

113557.synopsis:
On that unforgettable summer night, Chi Yu, who was going through a hard time, met a strange man.
That man crossed mountains and rivers to help him. He arranged his surgery, paid off his debts, and chased away the thugs who had come to harass him.
But Chi Yu didn’t believe that the man could be a good person.
Good people had never appeared in his life. So, this man wouldn’t be any different.
Just as he had expected, the strange man handed him a contract outlining several ‘obligations’ he needed to fulfill, along with the generous rewards he would be getting in return.
Yet, Chi Yu signed the agreement.
From then on, Chi Yu and the strange man named Xie Qingsheng started to live together.
Xie Qingsheng seemed to be a man with a strong desire to dominate and took his image very seriously.
With a frown on his face and a serious look in his eyes, he said, “You’ve become so thin. People will think I’m treating you badly.”
As he spoke, he would carefully scoop out some crab roe and serve it to Chi Yu.
While he coldly said, “Look at other people’s boyfriends, they have a gold card, how can you not have one?”
At the same time, he stuffed a black card with no upper limit in his hands.
He also solemnly said “I heard someone offered you five million to leave me? I’ll offer ten times that to make you stay. It’s enough to make them eat their words, right?”
Chi Yu: “…”
One day, the man gave his usual villainous smile and said, “Study abroad? Of course, you can. Watching my little bird fly farther than the others, the pride and sense of accomplishment I feel is better than any CEO’s.”
Chi Yu looked up at him for a moment, then hesitantly raised his hand to wipe the man’s teary eyes. “Then… why are you crying?”
_____
Gong PoV
In the previous life, Xie Qingsheng loved Chi Yu for his entire life.
Unfortunately, Chi Yu’s life was too short, and they met too late.
They were in love for two years and married for three—that was all the time Xie Qingsheng had with Chi Yu before death separated them.
After Chi Yu’s sudden death, Xie Qingsheng became an empty shell without a soul and purpose.
He lived his life aimlessly until he traveled 10 years back in time and met the hedgehog-like young Chi Yu.
He knew, young Chi Yu no longer believed there was any kindness left in the world.
Still, to stay by his lover’s side, he was willing to do whatever it took, even if it meant using the harshest and most despicable methods just to be with his lover.
With that, he stayed by his lover’s side.
Patiently waiting for the day when his lover’s icy heart would finally melt, and he would fall in love with him again.
associated_names: 一篇攻重生的古早小甜文

114581.synopsis:
A woman who doesn’t get passionate about love. 
A man who doesn’t get passionate about love. 
A man and a woman who don’t get passionate, even after long periods of dating, have fatefully met. 
~~~~~
“What kind of man?” 
“A man who can shine brightly just for one day by my side. Why do you ask? Are you going to introduce someone?” 
“If possible. What kind of man exactly are you looking for?”

When Magnolia woke up one morning, she found herself reincarnated in a world she didn’t recognize.
She had been 33 years old in her previous life, but now she’s a 3-year-old daughter of a marquis.
…However, it seemed her new family wanted nothing to do with her, and her second life was already looking rough.

Dragging others into her schemes (and sometimes getting dragged in herself), she boldly carves out a new life in this unfamiliar world.

115605.synopsis:
When Jiang Tingzhou is reborn, the first two things he does are: quit his job and break up immediately.
In his past life, after being lost at age five and then found again by the Jiang family—a family famous for their culinary legacy—he spent nearly half his life fighting against Jiang You, the adopted child who had taken his place. This false young master was deeply favored by fate, as if born under a halo of divine luck.
Jiang Tingzhou worked himself to the bone, fighting tooth and nail to prove that this little green tea (pretentious schemer) was inferior to him in every way.
He won the prestigious God of Cooking competition.
He brought Jiang Group’s restaurant chain to new heights.
Even the person Jiang You longed for but could never have fell in love with Jiang Tingzhou instead.
He poured every ounce of effort into proving that Jiang You wasn’t naturally worthy of love or admiration—there was no “main character aura.” As long as you worked hard enough, anything could be changed. He believed everyone should prefer him.
But in the end, his parents called him aggressive, his old friends drifted away, his coworkers talked behind his back about how cold and unapproachable he was, and the lover he’d forced to stay eventually left him.
Only his career had turned out well.
Yet just as he began to taste success, Jiang Tingzhou died from overwork. All he could do was watch helplessly as Jiang You played the part of a tragic, returning white moonlight and smoothly inherited everything he had built.
Then he found himself reborn—back at twenty-two, sick with a fever, still working nonstop, and being gaslit and bullied by his boss.
Wait a second… who even wants to be reborn?!
Jiang Tingzhou: [Dead fish eyes] .jpg
He’s officially given up on his luckless life. Deep down, he realizes that being reborn means nothing. Nothing he does ends well. No matter how hard he fights, it’s all for nothing. What’s the point of grinding if the end result is just emptiness?
Love, money, success—it’s all external. The only thing that’s truly yours is your body.
So he finds a quiet place to lie flat and gives up. All he wants now is three good meals a day. To eat well and live peacefully.
But strangely enough, once Jiang Tingzhou stops trying, people around him start to regret things. It’s like everyone suddenly starts liking him again.
Later, he even goes viral as the internet’s most desirable food vlogger?
#TopTierTemptationJiangTingzhou
#JiangTingzhouTheManYouCan’tSayNoToAfterMidnight
#ISeeHimAndTearsStartDrippingFromMyMouth
From the Gong’s POV:
Lu Baiyu went through a breakup that felt like falling off a cliff.
In their chat history, Jiang Tingzhou had always been the one sending dozens of messages, chatting nonstop in a sweet, clingy way.
“Hubby, miss you ❤️”
“Dreamed about you last night, I really really want to see you.”
“I made a new dish!”
“[Photo] ”
“When are you coming back to Yongqing? I want to cook for you.”
Lu Baiyu had been away on a business trip, working nonstop. He saw the messages but didn’t have time to reply—he was used to it.
Then, after finishing an international meeting, he opened his phone and saw a new message from Jiang Tingzhou:
“Hi. We’re breaking up. Bye.”
Lu Baiyu: …?
He sent a question mark.
But the chat showed a red exclamation mark.
Just like that, he was blocked—out of nowhere.
Pairing:
Former top achiever turned slacker culinary genius shou × aloof iceberg-type gong who goes feral when he loses his lover
Notes:
